title: Add bee herding interrupt and cancel verbs with registry entries
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee herding::job_verbs && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test registry_contracts --test registry_dispatch
action: Create `herding/job_verbs.rs` (declare `mod job_verbs;` in herding.rs beside the other modules ~:72-112 and add `interrupt` and `cancel` rows to the dispatch table at herding.rs:118-140). Both verbs take `<job-id>` positional plus `--main-root` and `--json`, resolve the mailbox with the existing helpers, read pane_id from job.json, and build the transport with `run::transport_for_run(main_root)` (run.rs:2774; make it pub(super) if needed). interrupt (D1 c943feb9): refuse typed with a FIX line (pattern herding.rs:618) when the job dir, pane_id, or the pane is missing, or the mark is cancelled/cancel_pending; else `pane_send_key(pane, key)` with key `esc` for herdr and `Escape` for tmux (pick by the transport kind the config names), `mailbox::write_mark(.., Mark::Interrupted, "user")`, print `herding: interrupted job <id> (pane kept open)` (JSON: job_id, outcome interrupted, pane_id, closed_pane false). Never close the pane. cancel (D4 7172010b, fail-closed): `process_info(pane)` -> pid (Liveness::Alive{pid}); write mark cancel_pending; pane_close; poll `crate::lock::is_pid_alive(Some(pid as f64))` every 100 ms up to 5 s; gone -> write mark cancelled, print `herding: cancelled job <id> (pane closed, pid <pid> exited)`, exit 0; still alive -> exit non-zero with JSON `error: cancel_termination_failed` and text `FIX: kill pid <pid> by hand, then run bee herding cancel <id> again`, mark stays cancel_pending. A second cancel on a cancel_pending job skips the pane step and only re-confirms the pid. When process_info is Absent (no foreground pid) close the pane and record cancelled at once; Unknown refuses typed (never report cancelled unconfirmed). Registry: the CLI registry is hand-maintained (decisions d515c1d7, 3358743e): add `herding interrupt` and `herding cancel` entries to generated/registry_payload.json in the shape of the existing `herding status` entry (it is one long line; edit surgically, never reformat), and extend the flag-count ledger comment in catalog.rs (~:390-430, style `Net +N: a -> b`). If the write guard denies the generated path, follow the remedy the deny names. Tests in job_verbs.rs with the FakeCockpit/FakeHerdr fakes from hcc-2: interrupt sends the key and writes the mark; interrupt refuses on a cancelled mark; cancel confirms exit and marks cancelled (fake whose process_info returns Absent after close); cancel on a fake pid that stays alive reports cancel_termination_failed and keeps cancel_pending (use the current process pid as the always-alive pid); unknown job refuses with a FIX line. Then run `cargo test -p bee --test registry_contracts --test registry_dispatch` green.
